clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed near the mountain passes connecting Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Worried for a fellow pilot lost in the hills, he seeks willing adventurers to search for his friend. His presence highlights the dangers faced by dwarves along the high alpine ridges.

Ironforge's siege engines are the pride of its Siege Brigade, but driving them across harsh mountainous terrain carries extreme risk. Stationed at the North Gate Outpost overlooking the border between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, Pilot Hammerfoot guards the pilots' engines and watches the mountain passes. When a pilot goes missing, finding him quickly becomes a priority, especially with savage beasts prowling the nearby hills.
